description: Redeem the user's Moneda Points for prepaid AI usage credits. Spends points (a negative points transaction) and grants the matching AI budget atomically. Enforces the minimum, the sufficient-balance check, and the monthly cap (see get_points_redemption_config). Pass a stable requestId (uuid) held across retries when you can: retrying with the same value is a no-op (returns granted:false). Omitting it is safe. The server derives the key from (user, points, 30s window) rather than minting a random one, so a retry still dedupes.

points.description: How many points to redeem for AI credits.

requestId.description: Optional idempotency key (uuid). Reuse the same value on a retry; if omitted the server derives one from (user, points, 30s window).

name: redeem_points
